prompt: Build solar water pumps for villages in Tharparkar
title: Thar Water Wells
tagline: Women in Thar walk 6 km a day for water. A solar pump gives that time back to a whole village.
story: In Tharparkar's desert villages, collecting water is a full-time job, mostly done by women and girls who walk hours each day to reach brackish wells.
With an engineering society and a local solar installer, we're fitting solar-powered pumps and RO filters on existing wells and training a village committee to maintain them.
Each pump serves around 400 people for over a decade. PKR 5,000 buys a solar panel. Let's bring water to three villages before summer.

impactUnits.label: RO filter cartridges for a year
Water storage tank for a village

faqs.a: A trained 5-member village committee, with a 3-year service contract from the installer.
There's no reliable grid in most of Thar, and diesel is expensive. Solar has near-zero running cost.

faqs.q: How many people does one pump serve?

whatsappPitch: 💧 Women in Thar walk 6 km every day for water. Students are installing solar pumps in 3 villages. PKR 5,000 = 1 solar panel. Help us finish before summer ☀️
